name: Brex Bill Pay
summary: Brex includes bill pay in its spend platform. The Essentials plan costs $0 per user a month and Premium costs $12, with Enterprise by quote. Brex's comparison table lists automatic invoice entry, multi-level approval flows and payment from a Brex account or an external bank account on all three plans. Payment fees sit on a separate rates page.

facts.text: Brex's help center says invoices can be uploaded directly or forwarded to Brex automatically.
Approval chains can route bills by amount and vendor and include a payment releaser, and a fully approved bill is paid on the chosen payment date.
Brex estimates domestic wires at 0 to 1 business days, ACH from an external bank account at 2 to 5 banking days, and checks at 7 to 10 business days.
Brex states SOC 1 Type II, SOC 2 Type II and PCI-DSS, and offers single sign-on through OIDC or SAML with Okta, Microsoft and Google Workspace.
The Brex platform agreement has no automatic renewal clause, and Brex may end it with 30 days notice.

hiddenCosts: ACH, wire and check fees are published on a separate rates and fees page and are not part of the plan prices.
The pricing page does not say whether the per-user prices are billed monthly or annually.

security.ssoPlan: Offered on Brex; plan not stated

contract.cancellation: The agreement runs until either side ends it. Brex may end it with 30 days notice, and a customer ends it by stopping use, clearing amounts owed and giving notice.
